large_file_detection.rationale: scripts/check-file-size.sh (200 KB limit, fixtures exempt) runs in .githooks/pre-commit and in the docs job of mission-branch.yml and gate.yml.

tech_debt_tracking.rationale: scripts/check-todos.sh enforces TODO(#issue) or TODO(B-nnn) in source files, in pre-commit and CI; BACKLOG.md tracks deferred items B-001..B-015 with reasons.

build_cmd_doc.rationale: README "Commands" table and AGENTS.md document make build/test/lint/check targets; same targets run in CI.

deps_pinned.rationale: No package manifest or lockfile yet (no Cargo.toml). Toolchain pinned in rust-toolchain.toml and actions pinned to digests, but no dependency lockfile exists to evaluate.

vcs_cli_tools.rationale: gh authenticated as dctellya with admin on the repository.

automated_pr_review.rationale: PR #1 has 0 reviews and 0 comments from automation; gate produces status checks and SARIF artifacts only, no generated review content.

agentic_development.rationale: All non-initial commits co-authored by factory-droid[bot]; .factory/hooks.json and settings.json configure agent hooks and mission models; ai/ holds the session logs.

fast_ci_feedback.rationale: gate.yml on PR #1: 14 jobs, longest 30 s (fs-scan), aggregate gate passed within ~1 minute of trigger. Well under 10 minutes.

build_performance_tracking.rationale: Swatinem/rust-cache is configured in workflows but no build exists yet; no timing is measured or tracked.

deployment_frequency.rationale: No releases, no deploy workflows; the gate never deploys by design (RULES rule 6).

single_command_setup.rationale: README "From a clean clone": git clone, make doctor, make hooks, make check. Documented sequence to the only runnable target that exists today.

release_notes_automation.rationale: Deferred: BACKLOG B-004 (git-cliff at first release).

monorepo_tooling.rationale: Skipped: single application, no build modules yet.

release_automation.rationale: No release or deployment pipeline; gate.yml attests and signs the bundle but does not publish a release.

agents_md.rationale: AGENTS.md at root (~6 KB): setup, build, test, QA path, layout, conventions, git rules, decisions, mission setup, env, do-nots.

readme.rationale: README.md documents purpose, status, clean-clone setup, commands, configuration, mission command, gate, observability, layout, honest time.

automated_doc_generation.rationale: docs/decisions/README.md is generated by scripts/gen-decisions-index.sh (make decisions-index); CI fails if it is stale (make check-decisions-index).

service_flow_documented.rationale: PRD §11 data sources and component diagram; README repository layout; D-003 CI flow; D-004 telemetry flow.

agents_md_validation.rationale: AGENTS.md commands are Makefile targets; mission-branch.yml and gate.yml run those same targets on every push/PR, so a broken documented command fails CI.

devcontainer.rationale: Deferred: BACKLOG B-001 (Tauri target is macOS).

env_template.rationale: .env.example documents GITHUB_TOKEN, FACTORY_API_KEY, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* (Grafana Cloud), OBSERVATORY_CONFIG, OBSERVATORY_LOG with keychain guidance.

local_services_setup.rationale: Skipped: no external services required locally.

runbooks_documented.rationale: Deferred: BACKLOG B-012. PRD troubleshooting prompts exist but no runbook.

branch_protection.rationale: Ruleset main-gate (id 25636994) active on refs/heads/main: pull_request, required_status_checks (gate, strict), non_fast_forward, deletion; no bypass actors.

secret_scanning.rationale: GitHub secret scanning enabled (API 200); gitleaks in pre-commit, mission-branch.yml and gate.yml; Semgrep p/secrets in gate.

automated_security_review.rationale: Semgrep and Trivy run in gate.yml and Trivy SARIF is uploaded as an artifact, but no readable report is posted to the PR and code scanning is not enabled (404 no analysis). BACKLOG B-013.

dependency_update_automation.rationale: renovate.json configured (grouped Cargo, pinned action digests, 7-day release age, weekly schedule). Renovate GitHub App installation pending by owner (D-005).

gitignore_comprehensive.rationale: .gitignore excludes .env (keeps .env.example), target/, dist/, node_modules/, .idea/, .vscode/, .DS_Store, local tool state.

privacy_compliance.rationale: Skipped: developer tool with no end-user data collection.

secrets_management.rationale: Keychain-first policy (AGENTS.md, config), .env gitignored with .env.example, workflows use secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN only, gitleaks enforced. No hardcoded secrets.

min_release_age.rationale: renovate.json: minimumReleaseAge "7 days" with internalChecksFilter strict; security advisories exempt (D-005).

issue_templates.rationale: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ with bug.yml, feature.yml, decision.yml and config.yml (blank issues disabled).

issue_labeling_system.rationale: 29 labels including type:* (bug, feature, chore, decision, security), priority:P0-P3, area:* (core, ingest, metrics, ui, gate, ci, docs, deps), needs-triage, fix-cycle.

backlog_health.rationale: No GitHub issues exist; backlog lives in BACKLOG.md by design. Nothing to evaluate against the issue-based criterion.

pr_templates.rationale: .github/pull_request_template.md with mission, what ships, evidence, decisions, deviations, left out, checklist.

lint_config.rationale: clippy configured: clippy.toml thresholds, make lint runs cargo clippy -D warnings -W clippy::cognitive_complexity in CI once Cargo.toml exists.

type_check.rationale: No code or build yet; no compiler is invoked. Rust will satisfy this once the walking skeleton lands.

formatter.rationale: rustfmt.toml committed; make fmt / fmt-check in pre-commit and CI; .editorconfig for all files.

pre_commit_hooks.rationale: .githooks/pre-commit (gitleaks, file size, debt markers, decisions index, rustfmt, markdownlint), commit-msg, pre-push; enabled via make hooks.

strict_typing.rationale: Skipped: Rust has no distinct strict mode.

naming_consistency.rationale: AGENTS.md "Conventions" documents Rust naming, event kind mapping from PRD names, test function naming, fixture file naming.

cyclomatic_complexity.rationale: clippy.toml cognitive-complexity-threshold = 25; make lint enables -W clippy::cognitive_complexity under -D warnings in CI.

dead_code_detection.rationale: RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings in both workflows turns rustc dead_code/unused warnings into build failures; cargo-udeps/machete deferred (B-014).

unused_dependencies_detection.rationale: Deferred: BACKLOG B-014 (cargo-udeps / cargo-machete once code exists).

unit_tests_exist.rationale: No code, no tests yet. Rule 1 (tests before code) applies from the walking skeleton.

integration_tests_exist.rationale: No tests yet; replay-fixture tests planned (make replay-fixtures).

flaky_test_detection.rationale: No retry configuration or flaky tracking; PR #1 shows no duplicate check names.

test_coverage_thresholds.rationale: Deferred: BACKLOG B-005 (cargo-llvm-cov with a stated threshold in the spec).

test_naming_conventions.rationale: AGENTS.md: unit tests in #[cfg(test)] mod tests, integration tests in crates/<crate>/tests/<topic>.rs, sentence-style test names, fixture naming.

interactive_qa_exists.rationale: AGENTS.md documents the future QA path (replay CLI, make app-dev, load fixture), but no application exists to bring to an interactive state today.

interactive_qa_runnable.rationale: Nothing runnable yet beyond make check.

api_schema_docs.rationale: Skipped: desktop app without HTTP API.

database_schema.rationale: Skipped: SQLite index planned, not implemented.

distributed_tracing.rationale: No code; OTLP tracing contract defined in D-004 and config, not implemented.

metrics_collection.rationale: No code; observatory.* metric names contracted in D-004, not instrumented.

code_quality_metrics.rationale: Code scanning not enabled (404); no coverage or Sonar. Trivy/Semgrep results only as artifacts.

error_tracking_contextualized.rationale: None; span-event approach decided in D-004, Sentry/Faro deferred (B-003).

alerting_configured.rationale: No alerting rules; Grafana Alerting intended once metrics flow.

deployment_observability.rationale: No deployments; Grafana Cloud documented as the backend but no dashboards or deploy annotations exist.

circuit_breakers.rationale: Skipped: no application code with external calls yet.

pii_handling.rationale: Skipped: developer utility without personal data.

log_scrubbing.rationale: Deferred: BACKLOG B-006. Hooks avoid logging tool responses, but no redaction utility exists.
